caption: The drawing depicts a single rooster standing in profile facing to the right. The rooster is rendered in black and white pencil or charcoal, showing detailed texture in the feathers, particularly around the wings, breast, and the large, fan-shaped tail. The comb on the rooster's head is prominent with pointed tips, and the beak is slightly open. Both legs of the rooster are clearly visible, with each foot gripping a cylindrical horizontal bar, which functions as a perch. The outline of the bar runs horizontally near the bottom of the composition. The entire image is centered within a rectangular frame that includes a thin border line around the edges. Beneath the bar on which the rooster stands, there is a small ruler for scale, marked with inch divisions from 0 to 9 inches. The background is unshaded and left plain, emphasizing the figure of the rooster.
title: Weather Vane Finial
